title:
A huge well done to everyone who took part in this week's football session! Your teamwork, determination, and energy on the pitch were truly inspiring. It’s amazing to see how much progress you’re making each week.   

The victory went to non-bibs this week with a very close final score of 11-10!! Well done to SM for winning our inaugural penalty shootout!  

No matter the score, your passion and effort make you all winners. Keep up the great work, and we can’t wait to see you at the next session! ⚽👏🎉

#BluePitsHousingAction #NewbarnLtd #Football #Fitness #Health
